description: This file defines the MidiDeviceAndroid class, which implements MIDI device functionality for Android within the Chromium project. It manages MIDI device ports, provides device info, and exposes methods for native code interaction.

classes.name: MidiDeviceAndroid
classes.description: A class implementing MIDI device functionality for Android, managing device ports and providing device info.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Returns true if the MIDI device is currently open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MIDI device and its ports.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns the MidiDeviceInfo associated with the device.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer name of the MIDI device.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product name of the MIDI device, with fallback for certain BLE devices.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the MIDI device.

methods.name: getInputPorts
methods.description: Returns the array of input ports.

methods.name: getOutputPorts
methods.description: Returns the array of output ports.
